items.title: Most Airlines Are Holding Back on Capacity — American Is Flying More
items.summary: American has made some capacity cuts, but they’re much more modest compared to that of its chief rivals Delta and United. Executives at the carrier said they were taking a more conservative approach to cuts due to volatility around fuel prices.

items.title: Wyndham’s Portfolio Overhaul: Budget Hotels Are Out, Higher Fees Are In
items.summary: Wyndham’s U.S. room count looks stable. What’s actually happening is a systematic swap — lower-fee economy hotels out, higher-fee midscale in.

items.title: IATA Makes Surprise Pick for New Leader, Skips Airline Veterans
items.summary: IATA has picked its first leader from outside the airline industry in four decades. The gamble is whether member carriers will take their cues from an economist who has never run an airline.

items.title: IndiGo Swings to Loss as Fuel Costs Surge Amid Middle East Flare-Up
items.summary: IndiGo charged more, earned more, and still lost money. Welcome to the brutal math of aviation.

items.title: IndiGo Co-Founder: Airport-Airline Ownership Is a ‘Massive Conflict of Interest’
items.summary: If the idea is to break the two-airline duopoly, the irony is hard to miss. India could end up replacing airline concentration with something even more powerful — a conglomerate that controls the skies, the gates, and everything in between.

items.title: EU Claims Google Buries Travel Rivals in Search as Part of $525 Million Fine
items.summary: Brussels has spent a decade litigating who sits atop the results page. This fine won't settle it. Expect the fight to drag on.

items.title: Travel Advisories Are Back and the Gulf Is Out With Flight Deals and Easier Visas
items.summary: Gulf hotels were already struggling before this month's headlines. A hoped-for recovery may get pushed out further.

items.title: 54% of Travelers Distrust Your AI Recommendations — Now What?
items.summary: AI is quickly becoming part of the travel customer journey, but consumer confidence isn't keeping pace. A new report from Wunderkind examines why trust has become one of the biggest challenges facing AI-powered travel experiences.
